title: Cauliflower Oatmeal
description: Adding cauliflower rice to oatmeal dramatically increases volume and fibre without adding many calories — a clever high-protein hot breakfast.
steps: If using whole cauliflower, grate florets into rice.
Add cauliflower rice to a pot with 250g salted water. Cook on medium heat 10 minutes.
Add oats and 50g more water; simmer stirring until thick and creamy (~5 minutes).
Add powdered peanuts and whey; cook stirring 30 seconds. Add splash of water if needed.
notes: Can also be refrigerated overnight for a cold version. Cauliflower taste is completely masked.
